data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** e0b3247a126d5a80ad5baaace5e86440efa154a3
* **Affected file:** `plugins/dso/scripts/pr-finalize-classify.sh`

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick

#### Expected Behavior

Behavioral test coverage for the classifier: at least one test per status code (MERGED, CONFLICTING, CHECKS_FAILED, THREADS_UNRESOLVED, CHECKS_PENDING, READY_TO_MERGE, BLOCKED_BY_REVIEW, UNKNOWN) using mocked `gh` and `gh api` responses; tests assert the output JSON shape and exit code. Additional tests for input validation (non-numeric PR, missing arg, missing branch match) and for graceful-degradation paths (graphql errors, malformed JSON).

#### Actual Behavior

The classifier was authored in PR #89 with manual smoke-testing only. The script parses responses from `gh pr view`, `gh pr checks`, and a GraphQL query. A change in any of those response shapes — or in the bash-vs-python interaction (e.g., the recently-fixed \${3:-{}} brace-misparse bug) — would silently break the classifier with no failing test signal.

Filed as P3 deferral from the PR #89 llm-review cycle 2 important finding. The classifier is currently used only by the PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md loop, which adds an agent-level sanity check (the workflow doc instructs the agent to inspect the JSON before acting), so the gap is bounded. But coverage would catch the next subtle regression.
data.title: [pr-finalize-classify]: no test coverage -> regressions in gh JSON parsing or status-code logic go undetected
